paragraphs.text: Tyrox is a Saurid warrior from Muraganda .

Tyrox is a notorious immortal of the Saurid Autocracy , known for both his brutal strength and clever tactics. When the Ghirapur Grand Prix came to Muraganda, Tyrox saw an opportunity to seize power. Once Avishkar 's diplomats left Muraganda believing they had brokered peace with the plane, Tyrox commanded his legions of raiders to set up ambushes in chokepoints along the track. The Autocracy was slow to respond to Tyrox's rogue actions, and the immortal believed that by capturing and hijacking the race's technology, he could claw tremendous power from the opulent, lazy dynasts back in the Autocracy's capital.
